name: com.threads.touchcontroller
description: Touch gesture recognition for Android, iOS and Windows touch (Surface) devices, built on the Unity Input System. Thresholds follow each platform's conventions in density-independent units and honour OS accessibility settings where they can be read.

samples.description: Surface (Windows) and Android demo scenes: finger markers, gesture toggles, an event feed and a card that turns gestures into intentions. Plus an Intentions Frame Demo: a frame you can drag from anywhere, even from its buttons, while a tap on a button still presses it, and its slider, list and text field keep their own drags. And a Joystick Demo: floating and fixed touch joysticks read through Input System actions. And a Gesture Actions Demo: swipes, taps, pinch and rotation bound to Input System actions. Rebuild the scenes from Threads > TouchController.
Editable copies of the shipped TouchSettings for Android, iOS and Windows. Assign one to TouchSystemOptions.Settings to change thresholds or the gesture lineup.
